title: Cozy Percy Priest Lakehouse Minutes from Downtown
description:
Charming lake retreat with 2 bedrooms (including a pullout sofa for kids), 2.5 baths, and a trail to Percy Priest Lake right behind the home. Close to downtown and Nashville airport.

The space
Bedroom 1: Queen bed + private bath
Bedroom 2: Full-size pullout sofa (best for children)
🚿 Bathrooms:
2.5 bathrooms for extra convenience 

Essentials Provided:
Fresh linens & towels
Basic toiletries
Iron & ironing board
Hair dryer
Curling Irons

Guest access
Entire home

Other things to note
What You’ll Love
🚗 Free parking on premises
📶 Fast Wi-Fi
📺 Smart TV for streaming
🧺 Washer & dryer
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen (stove, oven, microwave, coffee maker, cookware, dishes, utensils)
🧼 Dishwasher
❄️ Central heating & air conditioning
🛋️ Cozy living room with plenty of seating
🌿 Private trail access to Percy Priest Lake
☕ Outdoor patio (perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxing)
🛥 0.6 miles to Elm Hill Marina (boat rentals & Shipwreck Cove restaurant)
💦 Close to Nashville Shores Waterpark (open Memorial Day to Labor Day, fun for all ages!)
✈️ 4.5 miles to Nashville International Airport
🌆 20 min to Downtown Nashville 
🎸12 min to Opryland Hotel and The Grand Ol Opry
